events.title: Wyoming Obtained. Wind Rivers Imminent.
events.thought: Buttes Windmill to Fremont County in one session — the Dometic is humming, the cases are stacked, and the Wind Rivers are somewhere out there in the dark.
events.photoCaption: Interior of Waldo's habitat module with the pop-up roof deployed at camp. The Dometic fridge is on the left, and stacked aluminum expedition cases — including a rainbow trout sticker and the @waldo.roams decal — occupy the center of the bed.
